data.narrative:
Cascade Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Jacob Portukalian and Arlen Abraham, having raised $5.9M to date. The sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Rocket Lab and SpaceX, though direct peer valuation data at seed stage in this sector remains sparse.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: stage-progression analysis. Using the $5.9M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $14.75M. The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints at matching stage and valuation tier within Space & Aerospace—only 1 same-stage peer was identified against a threshold requirement of 3 or more. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's median 24.4x P/S multiple across the five public tickers is not feasible without the target's revenue figure, which private companies rarely disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered on $15M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue and unit-economics data, the narrow private peer set available for cross-validation, and the wide valuation multiples observed across public Space & Aerospace comparables. A fuller picture would require either revenue disclosure or access to additional seed-stage space company transactions.
